title: Zesty Sweet Dutch Apple Roast
description: A sweet and comforting Dutch dish featuring dulce de leche and roasted apples, perfect for a cold winter evening. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, dulce de leche, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, and toss until the apples are evenly coated.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and dot the top with the melted butter.
Bake the apple mixture in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the apples are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Zesty Sweet Dutch Apple Roast warm, garnished with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired.
